paper_title: Search for Axionlike Dark Matter Using Liquid-State Nuclear Magnetic Resonance
coupling_convention: g_ap gradient coupling in GeV^-1 (as quoted by paper; NOT converted to dimensionless)
notes: CASPEr-Gradient Low-Field commissioning measurement using proton NMR on thermally-polarized methanol. Searched ALP masses 5.576741-5.577733 neV (240 Hz window centered at 1.348570 MHz Compton frequency). No signal found; sets |g_ap| <= 3e-2 GeV^-1 at 95% CL across the scanned band (Fig. 3 shows per-step limits with ~50% daily-modulation variation, but only the summary value 3e-2 GeV^-1 is given numerically in text). Emitted as a flat two-point bound over the stated mass range. Standard halo model assumed with rho_DM = 0.3 GeV/cm^3, v0 ~ 220 km/s. Paper also mentions future projections down to ~1e-12 GeV^-1 with hyperpolarized 129Xe (Table I), but those are projections, not the reported limit. Coupling values are in GeV^-1 (derivative/gradient coupling convention), so downstream conversion to dimensionless g_ap would require multiplying by 2*m_p (~1.877 GeV). | selector: text over figure_vision (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 1, 0, 0.85, 2))
